result.summary: Current rebuilt Params binding started sidecamerad and produced matching cereal and VisionIPC frame IDs on the connected front-left feed. During the 8-second smoke, 122 unique VisionIPC frames and 117 unique cereal messages were observed with 117 matching frame IDs, 1280x720 geometry, and a 1,382,400-byte payload. Availability was true only for front-left while live and all false after SIGTERM. No TCP listeners appeared on 9007-9010. This proves current-binding startup and dual publication on one decoder; it does not prove 20fps acceptance or four-camera operation.

The separate earlier five-minute measurement recorded 19.999396661241942 mean fps, 123.185415 ms maximum EOF gap, and 743/5,999 intervals over 60 ms; AC-4 cadence acceptance failed. See evidence/runtime-smoke-zmq-r2-final.log and its prior typed probe for source lineage.

An initial controller attempt failed with a NameError before launching sidecamerad or opening the decoder; it is retained as evidence/runtime-smoke-r2.1-post-merge-harness-failure.log. The corrected run is this probe artifact.
